title: City of San Antonio Heat Level Response Plan - City of San Antonio, United States of America
landscapes: Arid, Athletics, Healthcare, Household, Institutional, Urban
description: To address heat conditions, the City of San Antonio’s Metropolitan Health District, the Office of Emergency Management, Bexar County, the National Weather Service and other community stakeholders coordinate efforts to increase public awareness on health risks and where to find places to stay cool during periods of excessive heat.
